reviews.text: [h1]“词”盘已满还有瘾？那就一起《超单词》[/h1] 总部位于英国诺丁汉，成立于去年三月的独游工作室MindFuel Games新到点进它超链接出现的是[b]发行商Pqube[/b]的主页，但本质是白胡子重开——遗老登上新时代的船。 这一次团队核心成员兼行业老将David Doak和Stephen John Ellis（曾参与过《007：黄金眼》等游戏开发），将枪口对准了《小丑牌》机制和Scrabble式经典拼字游戏的组合 （老友记也提到过这个游戏，见下翻译，不得不说瑞秋真神颜） （罗斯：……（冲着瑞秋）顺便告诉你，Y-O-U-省略号-R-E 读作“你是”，Y-O-U-R 才是“你的”！ 瑞秋：下头，分了！ 罗斯：+1 瑞秋：你就显摆你的拼写吧，留着周六晚上窝在家里跟你妹妹玩Scrabble填字游戏去吧） 这一次，我们不必像教条的罗斯一样，运用巧变的地形以及附着宝牌的单词，衔尾拼凑长短不一的词汇，在不断膨胀的超模倍率增益下通过[b]四十多种不同的关卡[/b]，并经受无尽模式的如潮考验。 作为母语非英的玩家，体验后感受比较难，但是本质上是把[b]生搬硬记变成相对生动的元音规则体验[/b]，上手门槛相对较高，但不论是对于是初学还是烂熟，都是比较不错的杀时良剂，但觉得如果是移动端，可能更能随时随地开一局。 [h2][b]不是书呆子的游戏，是赛博仓颉的地牢探险[/b][/h2] 玩家须利用字牌手牌架上的单词进行组词，开局词汇必须有字母经过起始点，接下来的词汇要么字母经过起始点要么必须[b]借已出的词中一个字母进行组词，[/b]组词顺序必须是从左到右或者从上到下（反了不会识别）。 除此之外，每一次出牌，必须将自己想出的字出在一列或者一行，不能东一榔头西一棒槌地天女散花，如果遇到发来的字牌不称心，那么右下角点击重置。 当我们完成如上的出牌行动，就会进入计分环节，本质上只需要记住三种颜色，[b]红色是基础分，蓝色是基础倍率，紫色是少见的奖励倍率[/b]，计分时候就是红蓝紫相乘即可，地图上的奖励点、商店可买的能力/道具、字牌上附着的宝牌效果，都可以依据这种颜色划分去进行简单理解，我们所追求的就是[b]三种变量乘积的最大化[/b]。 不同的字段长度和《小丑牌》中不同的牌型比较类似（可以升级），但由于英语拼字更加千变万化，如果没有主某一种长度的单词，可能反而最后没有办法打出高倍率，目前体验下来，3、4、5是最泛用的字段，也是我脑力的边界了。 不同的地图特性不同，到了特定关卡还会遇到38个boss之一（上debuff），不过好在，游戏分为金银铜三种奖杯，我们击败最简单的第一个boss就能解锁下一关。 说不定我们可以随着[b]爬塔购物获得或者拆35种随机卡包得到的46种天赋、56种道具、155种能力[/b]一口气连挑boss，直抵无尽模式。 当然，就像考试一样，很多时候未必出的词是自己所知的，而是现造的，本作种大部分不限时的关卡也正能帮助玩家摸到一些语感：英语里有句顺口溜：“When two vowels go walking, the first one does the talking”（两元音相遇，只发前一个音）。比如“TEAM”里的EA，“BOAT”里的OA，于是我们在造词的时候就可以多想很多元音词汇了。 这时候，代表元音癞子的“*”牌与代表26个字母癞子的“？”牌就有助于我们反复试到对了。 [h2][b]外置大脑的焚诀：寓教的玩法[/b][/h2] 如果真要给这个拼字游戏上些教育价值，那么它是很好的提示词工程学习工具，本质在于如果闯关卡壳了，往人工智能里面输入以下焚诀，会有奇效： 我的提示词设定是zero-shot的，肯定会有没那么智能的答复，但是如果游友有龙虾之类的本地部署，也许玩起来会更加丝滑。 提示词为： [i]【角色设定】你现在是一位精通《小丑牌》倍率计算与《Scrabble》高阶拼字策略的玩家。我的目标是在一款名为《BeyondWords》的游戏中追求单次出牌的最高乘积得分。[/i] [i]【核心算分规则】最终得分=红字(基础分)x蓝字(基础倍率)x紫字(罕见额外倍率)。请帮我在满足游戏规则的前提下，找出得分期望最高的拼写方案。[/i] [i]【[当前战况截图】[/i] [i]我的手牌(字牌架):如图*(注:代表任意元音，?代表任意字母)棋盘可用起始词/字母:如图我的主打词长(等级最高):4字母词场面高价值区域/宝牌:如图[/i] [i]【生成要求】请严格按照以下约束为我提供3个最优选词方案:必须包含棋盘上的起始字母。只能连成一条直线(单行或单列)，且从左到右或从上到下。并为该方案附上简单的中文释义与倍率触发解释。[/i] 周末的时候，这是一部画风萌丽且全年龄都能苦想的合家欢（本质有点类似二十四点那种，大家对着词板绞尽脑汁）。 虽然工作室在游戏简介中强调英语掌握度，但不难发现，如借助一定外置手段，这不是天堑；不一定非要以拿到金色奖杯为最终目的，拼到最后或许是如贪吃蛇一样自断生路，又或许是一个二字、三字词就能凑出大数，结果本身会因为不一的能力抓选运气而出现不同，但是游戏核心的乐趣在于对后天形成的谜题字板进行一次次组词化解，越到后期，对越苛刻组词条件破解带来的成就感愈浓。 [quote]欢迎关注 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45531068/]黑白测评[/url] [hr]黑夜显真 白昼辨伪

A really fun cross between Scrabble and Balatro but with lots of fresh ideas of it's own, The dev's have stated that no AI is in the final product and I have no reason to distrust them. Give the demo a go if you are unsure. I highly recommend it.

The guys known for consuming your entire childhood with games like Goldeneye and Perfect Dark are back to consume your entire adulthood with Scrabbalatro... sorry, Beyond Words. This game is so dangerous it should have a surgeon general's warning. I've played virtually all of the roguelike deckbuilders out there, and while there are several gems, none have really enraptured me in the same way as Slay the Spire or Balatro. I played the demo for this game for at least 5 hours, which by the way, good call on releasing that demo because it absolutely fully sold me on the game. That is to say that I'm certain this going to be added to that list of games that I lose my entire life to. I haven't yet played enough to get into all of the facets of the game or make recommendations on changes (if there are any) but I'm extremely confident in recommending the game. My playtime at review is reflective of nothing other than the fact that I have to be a responsible human and sleep.
Fun game if you like scrabble, im sure you'll like this game

I came here after playing Cursed Words (which is fun in its own way), and I appreciate that this game leans into the actual word building a lot more. If you've played Balatro, you pretty much know what you're in for here as far as structure, bosses, modifiers, etc. There are some clever twists and expansions on them as you churn through different levels. You get some nasty run enders along the way, too, but that's all part of the package, learning how to build to overcome them. If you're a Scrabble/Boggle fan that loved Balatro too, it's definitely worth a look.

A great blend of Scrabble and Balatro. It's been great on the Steam Deck too as a quick game to pick up and play. I liked the tactical element that the longest word might not always be the highest scoring with your powerups. My son also enjoyed helping over my shoulder to find words to spell and seeing the points go up. Would highly reccommend!

Couldn't stop playing this during NextFest. They definitely delivered on the Scrabblatro promise with a lot of polish. I'm going to dump a few dozen hours into this in the next few weeks. A compelling gameplay loop, solid sound design, clean graphics = happy customer.

Excellent game, as many others have said it's Scrabble Balatro and has all that entails. The fun for me is in playing the game more like scrabble as it has some issues when it comes to randomness nuking your runs. The randomness that nukes runs comes in the form of the boss modifiers, which frankly usually suck as they seem to destroy your build 99% of the time by disabling all your powerups either directly or specifying only certain lengths of words can be played (which usually renders your powerups ineffective entirely or severely nerfs them) which kind of spoils the fun. For instance I did a run where I built up 4 letter words to the point where they'd score ridiculously high through multiple means, the boss modifier just disabled three out of five powerups at a time ruining the build. Or another run where I'd built up a bunch of modifiers based around scoring longer words, the boss modifier was "only three letter words score." once again ruining everything. I think so far only one run didn't get nuked by boss modifiers out of about 10 or more. I'm still going to recommend this game based on it being scrabble with extra steps and that gameplay being fun, but I hope the Devs do some updates to make the boss modifiers a bit less cancerous and random.

After playing Balatro for 300+ hours, I was wondering if anyone was going to do a similar game but with words. This is that game, and it ticks every box I could've hoped for. Fantastic game, developers did a great job, just buy it :-)

This game needs a complete overhaul of its Balatro-esque mechanics. The scoring mechanisms are completely unbalanced and the bosses are utterly stupid beyond reason. Absolute waste of an hour to be enjoying a round for them to pull out the 4x required score boss at the end. You are at the mercy of RNG, which completely detracts from the whole point of a word game.
Gamified scrabble with some interesting twists. Very fun, my only gripe is I wish art direction was better. A unified theme could take this to the next level.

My new go-to lunch time brain sharpener. A fun new twist on Scrabble for sure. Heaps of incredibly challenging stages to partake in which have really made me reconsider my worth. I've not felt as unintelligent when faced with a pile of letters in my life. The fact that this is Steam Deck verified and has brilliantly intuitive touchscreen controls means a quick pick-up-and-play is never unachievable. Simple to get the hang of, but plenty of powerups will see you returning time and time again, trying to master it. Oh, and it allows for some pretty crude words - exciting. I've shared some absolutely horrific words with my friends, much to my delight.
This game is like the love child of Scrabble and Balatro. I love it!

Really well-designed game. It's Balatrofied Scrabble, but with a bunch of puzzle stage layouts and twists to keep things fresh. Each stage is a uniquely-shaped board with a curated set of tiles and rules. Rules can be things like "the board is cleared after every play" or having a timer tick down while you decide your play, and can also include perks or power cards that are in play from the start. I think there might be some stages that reduce the breadth of possible items in the shop, but I haven't played any of the stages enough to confirm that. Each board can award you a trophy for clearing a certain number of rounds, up to platinum. I really like this as an evolution of the Balatro formula, and I think it puts this game ahead of most of the "Balatro but <X>" games that have popped up in the wake of the original.

I love the feel of this game, Scrabble, Balatro and Slingo. The mood, Music and font choices are old school game nighty and I like the various ideas this game has. I can see myself spending a lot of time in this. It's fun and makes you think, We need more word games and this has a brilliant idea for it. Try the demo and see if it's for you!
This is such a good mix of scrabble and balatro. I love scrabble so this was a no brainer for me. AI Gen is not present in the final game (and demo). It was only used for the prototyping.

Generic man made ai level art is hilarious. The 10 man artist team they got for the art did a good job replicating ai, usually the ai replicates artist work but these lads did the unthinkable. Thankfully the game is brilliant. The janitor for Rare and Freeradical's HR guy made a good game here.
Scrabalatro
great concept

This is a time where I wish steam had a middle option between yes and no. The core gameplay and mechanics are great. This is easily the best scrabble meets balatro game out therem, and blends the two genres perfectly. If it was just this, this would be an easy recommendation, but it is everything around the game that prevents that. The balancing of the game is near nonexistent. There are many cards that are completely worthless or straight downgrades of others, and many cards that will practically win the run singlehandedly. The bosses also suffer from the same issue, with some being run killers for the majority of builds while others are minor annoyances at best. This leads to most runs just dying because you got the wrong boss with little to no ability to play around it. On top of the balancing, the graphics for this game are shockingly bad. Originally, all of the card art was AI, but after backlash the devs hired actual artists. However, judging from the current cards vs the trailer cards, it seems like the pretty much just redrew/traced over the cards, leading to almost all of them feeling weird and having a complete lack of a cohesive style. The UI is also very bad, and makes the whole game have a very cheap feel to it. Genuinely, if the devs just rebalance a few things and redo the art, this is easily a top five deckbuilder game that would be an instant recommendation. As it is now, it's incredibly hard to recommend unless you are a diehard word game fan. If you aren't, I'd wait to see if the devs address these issues. I'd be happy to update my review to a positive one if these problems get fixed.
It's essentially Balatro with Scrabble. But very very good it is too!

Super addicting, relaxing and cozy. Mix of balatro and Scramble. Was gonna pass up on it since Cursed Words was already fun to play but I'm glad I bought this one, too. Can get pretty challenging, too. Different boards/layouts and boss challenges and there's a lot of synergy with powerups. :)
Scrabbalatro. Having a blast. Thank you, Dr. Doak! Loved you in level 2: Facility.

Has a very fun design but the RNG is just deflating. There's no way to prepare for the boss levels that have random abilities such as "You randomly will not be able to use 3 powers but still have to gain an absurd amount of points". My first run ended because it didn't score anything over 2 letters and have to gain 1.5 million .

Yes, with caveats. The game is very fun. However, if you start pulling out semi-obscure words, like Hedonia, bailiff, etc. the game will not recognize it. I have lost at least a few runs to this. The mechanics are a blast though, its Balatro meets scrabble in a very pleasant way. Also you're allowed to use acronyms and proper names, but the acronyms and names allowed are also very random. Something as common as IBS or NFL might not be recognized, but then what appears to be a completely random scramble will register. Its a little frustrating at times, but hopefully they expand the in game lexicon with terminology from fields like law and philosophy so that more obscure words can be used. Overall, petty concerns aside, this game is a fantastic job by the devs. This is one I'll probably boot up on and off for years for some mindless fun.

Let's be honest, the only reason why you are here is because you loved the classic games that these two were involved in. Me too, that's why I bought this game even though it's a piece of crap. It's ugly, the balance is terrible, the boards are crap, it's incredibly derivative yet nowhere near as good as the source material. Yet I bought the game anyway, and didn't refund it. I willingly ripped myself off to donate to these elderly men who entertained me in my youth. That's how much I loved those games 💖

I've played a whole bunch of games with a premise similar to this one (i.e., "What if Balatro but with Scrabble?") and this one is my favorite. I like that you get a different board with each challenge; it adds more depth to the game, because now you aren't just figuring out which cards have synergies and plowing your way through by exploiting those combos; you are also learning how to play each new board to your best advantage. It's also got a pleasant, colorful interface and smooth, ambient music and SFX, which I consider an important factor when choosing from a bunch of different games that are otherwise structured similarly. An all-around delight.

From the legendary creators you'd expect to actually like video games, comes a rip off Scrabbalatro I don't even think they bothered to code properly. The balance of this game is nonexistent, which is wild because somehow you're supposed to beat a level with cards that don't even combat the brutal deficits and insane boss requirements this game suddenly foists on you. Unlocking more cards changes absolutely nothing, because most of them are just garbage fodder. Did anyone even play test this? Please don't get me started on the art, it looks like Beyond AI Slop! While they don't admit to using AI on their page, it's pretty glaringly obvious they... used it for development blah blah blah... you know the exact same excuse every dirtbag studio is conjuring up these days when they get caught. I went ahead and donated three times what I spent on this slop to real developers to counter balance such a heinous atrocity. Investigating PQube after the fact and seeing how nefarious they were to other studios is the rotten cherry on top. From stealing diversity grant money meant for a studio of underrepresented developers to blatantly ripping off developers who met their milestones but never received a penny... what a UK ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥. It's truly Beyond Words that this was such a bad experience.
Solid scrabble + balatro mashup. Each level has its own twist so you have to switch up your strategies. Pretty fun and addictive gameplay. Try the demo if you're unsure.

This is a very fun game. It's also a game that REALLY needs a bigger dictionary than it has. Sometimes it doesn't recognize some pretty basic things, let alone obscure things. It also lacks many oriental words that are fairly widely recognized in English (many of which are common enough to be in major dictionaries). This leads to it feeling somewhat random what you can and cannot score with, because it has a mix of bizarrely obscure words that I only find by putting random letters in place and then a bunch of things it doesn't take that are more common. If your lexicon is broad you may ironically find yourself frustrated in this word game because of that. It also purports to accept proper nouns, but lacks a ton of common names (especially last names) like Lopez. Regardless of those complaints, it's still a fun game and I do recommend it. I just hope they add a few more dictionaries to their list of accepted words.

Content Warning: 本评测包含过多 snp 元素。 一言蔽之，试图照搬小丑牌的 roguelike 游戏，十有八九都是 [spoiler]「苟矢」[/spoiler]。这个游戏也不例外。我甚至不想用「款」这个量词。 Pros: 想不出。 Cons: - [i]“来自《GoldenEye》与《TimeSplitters》制作团队的全新力作。“ [/i] 这两个游戏是什么？我一点都不知道，我是冲着游戏的单词属性来的。 - 动画过于宝宝巴士，拆封补充包甚至只是简单的摇晃 + 闪光，可见制作组在动画方面非常不用心。 - 同样是动画，学学人家小丑牌，动作越多，到后面的动画播放越快。到你这反而只有玩家自己设置的播放速度。到后面加成多了，填词五分钟，动画一分钟，一局下来能[spoiler]像便秘一样[/spoiler]打个四五十分钟，最后还不一定会通关。 - 说到关卡，关卡设计也非常不 rogue，虽然打到第三关铜杯就能解锁后续关卡，但是后面的关越来越离谱。与其说是 roguelike，不如说是换皮闯关游戏。 - [i]”本游戏需要您具备良好的英语水平方可游玩。“[/i] 写评测的时候看到简介里这句话气笑了。和所有的拼词游戏一样，这个游戏不需要你掌握太多词汇，而是了解哪些固定的单词能拼成小词。本人英语专业八级 70 分擦线良好，毕业后闲着没事把词汇量堆到了 20k，玩这个游戏依然[spoiler]像便秘拉矢一样[/spoiler]吃力。 总之别买。这游戏五块钱都 [spoiler] 他妈的 [/spoiler] 不值。 哦对了，游戏的中文名建议写成 [spoiler] 逼养的单词 [/spoiler]。

Very enjoyable game and quite different in its format. I would give it 4 out of 5 stars as some of The Boss rounds are very hard and sometimes make the round truly impossible, and you then can't progress. I don't mind rounds being hard, but making a round impossible is just frustrating and stops it from being fun. Otherwise, a great game.
This is the absolute best game to play with my morning coffee. It's like a mix of Balatro and Scrabble. Don't rush, make a good build, and watch the numbers (and your vocabulary) grow.

Balatro meets Scrabble roguelike ,fun game can be tough to start with but as you unlock more power and boost cards and get used to the scoring system and how to power build it gets easier .That said i'm now into later boards and there are some tough boards that you have to think about and puzzle out but 107 hrs in and 73% completed or unlocked i'm still enjoying it. 100 hrs for the price of the game its great value.

I usually do more hours into a game before I give an opinion and I may edit this review later, but for me this is a solid recommend. I wanted to help promote this game as it is still early and still getting patches and updates which is AWESOME and I want to encourage that. I was never a fan of roguelites until I played Balatro. It had a very satisfying ramp in difficulty and unlocks that made it a fun romp. Many games have tried to duplicate that fun and unfortunately failed, including a ton of somewhat popular word games. (Looking at you Wordatro)... BUT this one seems to get the closest for me to the Balatro feeling, edging out my previous favorite PIP My Dice. Is it perfect? NO - It needs a better tutorial (or maybe I somehow skipped it). I don't think I still understand the color of the tiles. The balancing is getting better as more patches come in, and it is still being actively worked on which is great. I hope that some mods will come along to enhance the experience as that is what made Balatro 10000X better for me even tho it was pretty good to start. TO ALL GAME DEVS: this is the literal 1000 time I ended up buying a game ONLY because it had a demo!!! (looking at you rocket league). Given the many disappointments I have had with word based balatros, I would never have bothered without the free demo, now I own the full version. Anyway, great game if you like scrabble and Balatro: for now 8/10 but I am still early in the game so there may be some adjustments along the way, but lets see more games like this!!! PLEASE leave the game open for modders....

There are very few games, even of those I enjoy, that I immediately think, "Wow, I need to go tell several friends about this because of how much they'll love it." This is one. Balatro, but scrabble, and superbly well executed. Also fantastic for couch co-op mode with a partner.

I wish I played more of the demo as while I really enjoyed the very early game, I'm starting to dislike it now after a few hours. Don't get me wrong, I love the Scrabble meets Balatro premise. But the game overall just isn't fun for me. It's mostly due to the vague UI and the (so far) fairly boring tiles and boosters. My biggest pet peve is how the game doesn't tell you the total word score (after multipliers etc) before you play it, especially because the way multipliers (and multipliers of multipliers) work is confusing. Sometimes I make a lot more points with a word and I exactly don't know why. While I am quite good at Scrabble, I'm terrible at this game and can't get gold in anything but the beginning tables. I'll keep playing to try get my moneys worth but at the moment I'm just not enjoying the experience.

Great game yes.... But very very testing. There are few levels that are very hard to grasp the scoring on and now have become impossible almost to get passed. But yeah it's a good game if bought on sale or try the demo first.

I absolutely love Scrabble. Therefore, this game was very appealing to me. Scrabble receiving the Balatro treatment. And generally it works! However, it's not perfect, here are my pros and cons. Pros: * Satisfying to string together some huge combos with power cards and boosted tiles. * The game is challenging, requiring a nice combination of skill and luck to get the gold and platinum trophies. * Great game to pick up and put down if you only have 15-30 minutes to play. Cons: * I wish there was more flexibility in achieving huge scores via Power Cards. A lot of the conditions present for multipliers are simply too obscure and don't provide enough impact to justify (example, small multipliers or point bonuses for spelling digits or names of planets -- these are not easy to do in a game and should be rewarded more significantly. * When you pull off huge combos, the ability to fast forward or skip the point scoring would be much appreciated. It takes so long sometimes. * Some maps are very gimmicky, requiring pure luck such as the train map where you need bombs or a certain card to break through the stones. I must have played that level 20 times and never got one. Ended up with a platinum score otherwise, but it was frustrating to feel so inhibited by luck. * One thing I loved about Scrabble was the double and triple word score. These oddly aren't present as tiles within the game. Sometimes it felt like my longest words scored insignificantly, which seems counterintuitive. Overall: I really enjoyed this gem of a game. Very well-priced, works great on the Steam Deck, worth your time if you love Scrabble and Balatro!

Real decent scrabble roguelike. I like the different shaped boards and the amount of cards/boosters to play around with even if some of the cards are so clearly overpowered. My main gripe is that the tutorial is a bit too broad and I would like it to go into more specifics (colored tiles, how each board can give you different letter tiles, etc), and also I would love for there to be a way to hover over a word to get a dictionary definition so I can understand how the game clocks certain abbreviations, and learn new words when I'm surprised when something was accepted lol. I like playing for 20 minutes at a time, it's perfect for that.
Enough here to modify each run and make the game completely different. Very enjoyable. Well done

This deck-builder has so much replayability and is just challenging enough to keep coming back to. It's scrabble meets a puzzle with powerups and fun quirky design pieces. Cannot stop myself from going back to it.

This may start out as a word game but once you hit the E-notation stage it becomes more of a math game. Some of the power cards are absolutely insane. And if you get lucky while shopping between rounds...duplicate, duplicate, duplicate...you can easily end up with a slew of very powerful cards. There are platinum trophies beyond the gold if you play endless mode. I didn't discover this until halfway through the levels and had to go back to complete the easier ones. Getting all platinum on every level was like beating every Balatro deck on gold stakes. And this game does have that Balatro feel for me. I'll probably go for some of the harder achievements now but what I really want are more levels. Or better yet a level editor that allows the sharing of designs between players.
fun
Best word game out there, if you've left this game a negative, you are an idiot. 10/10

It's pretty fun, but if you're expecting a Scrabble-type game this isn't really it. Because of the way the scoring system works, the words you actually make are fairly irrelevant and it's more about the 'score level' of their length and whatever multipliers you have. At the higher levels, the actual letter values, for the most part, have barely any bearing on the score of your word. I also think the game relies too heavily on wildcards which is another reason why it doesn't feel like Scrabble. Also, the letter Y should count as both a vowel and a consonant since it can be both.

Got this game because I read about it in retro gamer and wanted to the boys from rare who bought us goldeneye. Actually turns out it’s super fun and addictive, like balatro with words, and I find making words more interesting than making poker hands

Balatro with a "scrabble"-skin. Which means luck plays a devastating part in whether you proceed or not. And roguelike on top of that. I destroyed a run with an incredible score using nothing but lazy 5-letter words and on another occasion got absolutely nowhere when using 7-letter words or higher. The latter because I only got cards supporting words with 2 or 3 letter words. Like balatro it was lot's of fun playing it for a few hours and then nothing but frustration later on. It's not a bad game, but roguelike + a ridiculous amount of rng feels like a waste of time (and potential) to me.
It could be good but gets too hard way too quick. Only get it at a discount.
